name: Kagura Gakuen Ki
source:
A murder case happens at school. Nazuna is a miko. She is often sent to the scene of the crime when the case is about monsters. As she investigates the case, she meets Kouta. He is actually half human and half monster. Nazuna starts pursuing him. But one day, a female student goes missing... Also, Ibuki, another miko, transfers to the school...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
学校里发生了一起杀人案。荠是一名巫女，每当案件涉及妖怪，她常被派往犯罪现场。调查过程中，她遇见了航太，而他其实是半人半妖。荠开始追捕他，可某天，一名女学生失踪了…此外，另一位巫女伊吹也转入了学校…
